opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search with fare sort and selection
opportunities.description: Search flights on booking.com by origin, destination and departure date (one-way, or multi-city with several legs), sort results by Fastest, then pick an outbound flight and continue to the next step.
steps: Click the Flights tab.
If the trip is multi-city, click Multi-city and set each leg.
Click the origin field, type the origin city, and click the matching suggestion.
Click the destination field, type the destination city, and click the matching suggestion.
Open the departure date picker, click the departure date, and click Done.
Click Search.
Click the Fastest tab to sort results.
Click See flight on the top result, click Select, then click Next.
parameters: for multi-city: second-leg origin, destination and date

instances.values: One-way: origin 'banglore', destination 'goa', departure 29 March 2023. Sorted by Fastest, first result selected.

Multi-city: leg 1 New York to Tokyo (13 May 2023), leg 2 Tokyo to New Delhi (5 June 2023). Sorted by Fastest, first result selected. The 590.2 'Airport taxis' click looks like a stray action and is included only because it is contiguous.

opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search by pickup location and dates
opportunities.description: Search rental cars on Expedia by pickup location, pickup and return dates, optional times and sort order, then run the search.
steps: Click the Cars tab.
Click the Pick-up field, type the pickup location, and click the matching suggestion.
Optionally click Same as pick-up for the drop-off location.
Open the pickup date picker, click the pickup date, click the return date, then click Done.
Optionally set Pick-up time and Drop-off time from the dropdowns.
Click Search.
Optionally set Sort by in the results page.

instances.values: Pickup JFK (New York, John F. Kennedy Intl.), drop-off same as pickup, 3 Apr to 6 Apr 2023, pickup 9:00 AM, drop-off 6:00 PM, sorted by Total Price.
Pickup San Francisco, California, 2 Apr to 8 Apr 2023. No times or sort set, and no drop-off location set.

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search by destination, departure port, month and guests
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by sail-to destination, optional sail-from port, optional departure month, and number of guests, then run the search.
steps: Click Sail To and choose the destination region or port.
Optionally click Sail From and choose the departure port.
Optionally click Dates, then choose the month.
Click SEARCH CRUISES.
Optionally click Number of Guests, increase the guest count, and close the panel.
Re-run the search if needed.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco, CA, month October 2024. Searched.
Sail To Caribbean, no departure port or month set, guests increased to 4.

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero airport parking by airport, optional parking start and end dates, and an optional sort order such as Shuttle Time.
steps: Click the Airport tab.
Click the airport search box, type the airport name, code or city, and click the matching suggestion.
Optionally click Parking Start Date and choose the start and end dates.
Optionally change the Featured sort dropdown (for example to Shuttle Time).

instances.values: Airport 'jfk' resolved to John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), dates 18 Apr to 20 Apr 2023, sort Shuttle Time.
Airport 'Dallas Love Field' resolved to Dallas Love Field (DAL). Dates and sort not recorded in this occurrence.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up planned work or service changes on the MTA site for a given bus or subway route, optionally moving to a specific date in the calendar.
steps: Click the Planned Work or Planned Service Changes link.
Click the Search Routes box, type the route name, and click the matching route in the list.
Optionally open the date picker, move to the target month with Next Month, and click the date.

instances.values: Route '4', date 12 Apr 2023 opened, moved to next month, May 3 2023 selected.
